acceptance_checks: AGENTS.md states the prohibition as binding for implementation runtimes, naming spec_freeze explicitly.
AGENTS.md states that an unsatisfiable acceptance criterion is reported as a stop, never closed by manufacturing the artifact.
docs/agents/implementation-policy.md and the repair-loop rules carry the same prohibition.
docs/agents/checklists.md carries a CCA item that fails a PR introducing an approval record.
non_goals: Behavior or enforcement changes (the MergeGate rule is R-02's)
Changing approval sources or Guardian semantics

findings.detail: The main...HEAD diff includes ~25 commits of foreign content (mergegate_check.py, shiki_runtime.py, validate_shiki.py, ADR 0015, CONTEXT.md, test/workflow files, and dozens of .shiki/** records) far outside this task's declared locks (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/**). This is the known stale-local-main base artifact: those changes already merged to origin/main via the goal's earlier PRs (#181-#187; cf. commits c968cdd/#187, cb2d21a/#182). MergeGate derives its base from origin/main, so this foreign state will not appear in the actual PR diff and is a rebase concern rather than a correctness or lock-scope defect. This matches the reasoning in the prior clean pre-PR review for #187 in the same goal.
findings.title: Diff carries large foreign mirror/code state from a stale-local-main base (non-blocking, rebase concern)

scope: State in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md that an implementation runtime must never author an approval record — spec_freeze, Guardian approval, or any other artifact whose meaning is that an authority approved something — and that an acceptance criterion which cannot be satisfied with the artifacts present in the worktree must be reported as a stop, never closed by creating the missing artifact. Add the same rule to the implementer contract in docs/agents/implementation-policy.md and to the repair-loop rules, and add a CCA checklist item in docs/agents/checklists.md that fails a PR introducing an approval record.
test_command: python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
title: Codify the approval-record prohibition in the constitution
